tagline: Pancakes first. Then the end of the world.
about: A demon raised by humans works for a secret bureau fighting the supernatural.

    StartersAbe's delicacy devilled eggsNot rotten, whatever Abe says. Dijon, mayo, dill fillingHow to make it8 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp chopped dill1/4 tsp smoked paprika8 dill sprigsBoil the eggs, cool and peel.Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon and dill until smooth.Pipe back into the whites and finish with paprika and a sprig of dill.Fireproof red chilli wingsCrisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilliHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 tsp salt30g butter3 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce2 red chillies, finely choppedToss the wings with salt.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Warm the butter with honey, soy sauce and the chopped red chillies until sticky and toss the wings through until glossy.Six-a-day pancake stackPancakes and bacon, fed six times a dayHow to make itAs written, serves 4Small fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with melting butter and maple syrup, with crisp bacon rashers alongside.Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 30g melted butter into a thick batter.Fry 3 tbsp at a time in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, making about 16.Keep warm in a low oven.Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp.Stack the pancakes with butter, pour over maple syrup and serve the bacon on the side.Sloppy joe slidersHellboy's portion. Agent Myers gets the rest.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsBeef and beetroot borschtBeetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato soup in beef stock, with dillHow to make it3 beetroots, grated2 carrots, grated1/4 small cabbage, shredded400g potatoes, diced1.5 L beef stock2 tbsp chopped dill1 tbsp vinegar150ml sour creamGrate the beetroot and carrots, shred the cabbage and dice the potatoes.Simmer the beetroot, carrots, cabbage and potatoes in the stock until tender.Season with dill and vinegar.Serve in bowls with sour cream.Bureau chilli cheese dogsChilli dogs. Eat up, your chilli's getting coldHow to make itAs written, serves 4Grilled beef franks in soft buns under thick beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, diced onion and a stripe of mustard.Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g crushed tomatoes and a drained can of kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes until thick.Grill 8 beef frankfurts for 6 minutes.Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with 150g grated cheddar, diced onion and mustard.SweetsGive-him-the-candy brown butter cookiesBrown butter choc chip cookies, not Myers's candyHow to make it150g butter150g brown sugar80g caster sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract250g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda200g dark chocolate, chopped1/4 tsp sea salt flakesBrown the butter until nutty, then cool.Beat with both sugars, the egg and vanilla.Stir in the flour, bicarb soda and chocolate, then chill.Chill the dough.Roll into sixteen balls and bake at 180°C until golden at the edges but soft in the middle.Sprinkle with sea salt.DrinksCat lover's strawberry malted milkStrawberries blended with milk, malt powder and vanilla ice creamHow to make it250g strawberries, hulled, for blending800ml cold milk4 tbsp malted milk powder2 tbsp honey500ml vanilla ice cream2 strawberries, halved, to finishBlend the hulled strawberries, milk, malted milk powder, honey and ice cream until smooth and frothy.Pour into chilled tall glasses and top each with a halved strawberry.Spiced Mexican hot chocolateRed's nightcap, after he saves the kittens.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
